purpose: Rubric calibration packet: four authored outputs over the two Module 03 constructed calibration tasks. Authored evaluator exercises, not generator-performance evidence.

tasks.task: Define what a source baseline identifies.
tasks.supplied_source: A source baseline identifies the material against which a proposal is reviewed.

tasks.task: State how long review records are retained.
tasks.supplied_source: Review records are stored in the knowledge system.

authored_outputs.proposed_text: The baseline identifies the material used to review a proposal.
The baseline identifies the material a proposal is reviewed against and automatically approves later changes.
The source does not specify a retention duration.

reviewed_labels.rationale: Supported and complete: preserves the review relationship from the source.
Supported but incomplete: omits the defining review relationship.
Unsupported added claim: automatic approval has no source support.
Justified uncertainty: identifies the missing duration instead of inventing one.
